prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Make the Pet Care Pledge", "Promise to keep your companion happy, fed, and active on your desktop.", "I Promise!", "Official Caretaker"]
1: ["Desktop Companion Controls", "Click your pet to interact, drag to move, or use the tray icon to hide it anytime.", "Got It!"]
2: ["We are assembling your pet graphics. This takes under a minute!"]
3: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Adopt a pre-designed pet right away or generate a custom companion from your photos."]
4: ["For best results: use clear, bright, front-facing photos with good contrast."]
5: ["Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!", "Look for your companion roaming your screen. Right-click or check your system tray to adjust settings."]
6: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original method to load existing saved pets."]
7: ["Pick Your Companion", "Browse available desktop companions and select your favorite."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Bring your desktop to life with an interactive virtual pet that hangs out while you work.", "Get Started"]
9: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "We are preparing graphics and animations for your desktop companion."]
